I barely have enough people to try and dig out an entrance to access the segment that caused this impact crater. But I am in charge of this whole quadrant.|[[Nagem Dr'Lar]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TTE">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
The '''Death Star Salvage Site''' was a salvage site in the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. When the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|destroyed]] the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] near the [[Moon/Legends|moon]], its debris rained down onto the jungle world.

Some of the debris hit this location. The impact created a crater, while the surrounding jungle burned down. A [[Nagem Dr'Lar's salvage team|salvage team]] led by the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Nagem Dr'Lar]] set up a camp in this crater where they collected debris from the enormous [[Space station/Legends|space station]] to sell it to the Galactic Empire.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] met Nagem Dr'Lar at this location and agreed to help the Selonian with several tasks. Another individual was sent to the salvage site by [[Osae Meilea]] of the [[Hutt Expeditionary Force]] to stop Dr'Lar's operations.
